name: @ground-truth/getcache-offlinemap
description: Offline map engine. A CHILD: takes its host as HostPorts props and stands alone without one.
_why_vitest_config: vitest.config.ts is NOT the build config the line below forbids. `.svelte.ts` files hold runes ($state), which are COMPILER syntax: unless the svelte plugin transforms them, they reach node as an undefined global and every test in the file dies with `$state is not defined` — 31 of them did, and a suite that is permanently 31-red teaches everyone to ignore it. The parent already ran these same files green through its own svelte() plugin, so the code was never broken, only the bare-clone runner. The plugin and svelte are devDependencies here for the reason in _why_pinned: they resolved only by workspace hoist, which is the same silent borrow that let the pbf break hide.
_no_build_on_purpose: SUPERSEDED 8 Sep 2026. This child ships its own svelte.config.js and vite.config.ts, generated by gitEr/dressChild.sh alongside _rapper/, so a bare clone runs: npm install && npm run dev. The old rule (a child is a folder a parent builds) made rapper and an npm publish the only way to assemble a runnable app, which put a registry between a developer and the code. Mounted inside ReTreever nothing changes: the parent supplies its own config and ignores these.
_why_pinned: Versions match what ReTreever runs, because that is the version the code was written and tested against. They were all "*" until 25 Aug 2026, which is not a constraint but a wish: the workspace install resolved pbf to 5.1.2, which dropped the default export, and the build died on `import Pbf from "pbf"`. Nested inside a parent the child silently borrowed the parent's version and the hole never showed. A child that is genuinely portable has to state what it needs.
